text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A and Stock E after gains, and Stock B after a smaller gain; I should not sell just to lock in the satisfaction of a profit.","I should judge each holding by its prospects and the role it plays in my whole portfolio, not only by whether it is above my average cost.","Since I trade infrequently, I should make deliberate decisions using clear rules rather than reacting to short-term account changes."]}
